500 Park Avenue

September 25, 2018
Michael E. Bleich
Alexis K. Bleich

13 Harrison Street, Unit |
New York, New York 10013

Re: Bleich - OPEH LLC Promissory Note

Dear Michael and Alexis:

The maturity date of the Promissory Note executed by you on January11, 2018 (the
“Note’) was September |, 2018. Payment has not been received, and you are under default of
the Note in accordance with Sections 7(i) and 7(ii) of the Note.

The Principal Amount of Two Million Two Hundred Thirty-Three Thousand Seven
Dollars ($2,233,007.00) and the accrued interest in the amount of One Hundred Fifty-Five
Thousand Seventy Dollars ($155,070.00) is due and payable immediately to OPEH LLC.

Your failure to remit full and immediate payment of Two Million Three Hundred Eighty-
Eight Thousand Seventy-Seven Dollars ($2,388,077.00) is resulting in the accrual of additional
interest at the default rate of 15% per annum.

OPEH LLC will take all available steps to enforce the Note. All rights reserved.

OPEH LLC

Sincerely, ZA =
